notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Fixes Generic Gamepad users and Steamdeck controller users not having all keys mapped correctly causing the game to slowly be filled with silent errors and break the game
- A huge thanks to Mushashi for finding this bug and reporting it to us.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes: Optimizes the tutorial and adds checks to help avoid potentially getting stuck waiting for animation to finish

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Endless & Tutorial
notes.notes:
- Fixes tutorial having a potential to soft-lock
- Removes loading screen from subsequent battles with Rogue.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Fixes final boss ability not triggering correctly under certain conditions (spoilers!)
- Minor optimization to scene transitions

notes.title: Update v2.5.5
notes.notes:
Fixes

 Cards not being selectable after paginating while the cursor was on them
 Cards become not focused when changing pages even when the cursor was on them
 Shield ability not playing when blocking a token
 Shield ability playing when the card is captured
 Tinker percentage not resetting when removing the token being tinkered
 Theme drop-down in PvP remaining active for the non-host player

notes.title: Version 2.5.3 is out now!
notes.notes:
What's New or Updated?

 Adds unique sounds for each critter
 Adds using ESC to close out of menus
 Adds the use of the back button to discard a token
 Removes the intro dialogue when replaying the tutorial match
 Adds the use of the back button to return to the island from the store
 Adds a "remove" button in the Tinkerer to clear the tokens being used for tinkering
 Adds "elements" as a filters to indicate which tokens to display according to their element


Bug Fixes

 Fixes localization typos
 Fixes starter pack not properly shuffling arrow distribution
 Fixes the "total play time" not displaying correctly after 24 hours of gameplay
 Fixes tokens not detecting that the cursor was over them when paginating, sorting, or changing menus


What's Next?
We are working on the finishing touches for the first iteration of PvP Battle! 
This is scheduled to be released by end of June 2024.

notes.title: Version 2.5.2
notes.notes:
What's new?

 We've added windowed mode!
 Additional NPC/Token rebalancing
 The names of the regions are now visible
 Relabeled "Beta" in main menu to "Early Access"
 We changed the shop song to avoid twitch triggering copyright infringements
 A region will now be marked as perfect if all NPCs on that region have been perfected


What's Next?
We are actively working on PvP, only taking breaks to address bugs/improvements as new players communicate the issues. We will be adding PvP to early access as soon as it is available as we would love the help from the community to vet out any issues we might have overlooked.

We are also talking about what a "roguelike" mode would like as post-game content. 
Thanks again to all who have purchased the game, reviewed it, and have provide us with feedback to improve the game. Discord is always the best place for your feedback to be heard and we would love for you to stop by and let us know how we can continue to make this game even better for you.

Sincerely,
Attack on Hex Island Development Team

notes.title: Version 2.5.0
notes.notes:
Fixes & Updates:
[olist]
 Adds display settings which allows you to change resolution and enable/disable borderless mode
 Adds a failsafe to prevent the screen to stay black after a cutscene is done
 Adds a notification icon when there's something new in the boat
 Adds a more accessible way to exit the ship
 Updates element chart with names and new icons to better represent what each element means
 Settings such as text animation are not global and will persists across playthroughs
 Fixes initial cursor speed being set to the lowest
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 2.2.5
notes.notes:
Quick Fixes/Updates

 Tinkering now auto populates the tokens, similar to the hand, starting with the token to tinker and then filling up the tokens used for tinkering
 Updates the battle previews to show when a token is receiving an attack boost
 Adds additional achievements
 Fixes the achievements related to capturing a certain amount of tokens in a single move
 Fixes incorrect sound effects playing when devolving
 Fixes wait times after placing tokens down when a bomb was not triggered

notes.title: Updated to version 2.2.3
notes.notes:
Improvements

 Three new token abilities
 Three additional achievements
 You can now gain money from defeated opponents
 Updated Battle Ready Menu to show NPC level and bombs
 Updated NPC hand building to ensure it matches the elements shown before battle

Fixes

 Currency tracker taking too long to show available funds
 Bomb captures sometimes showing the wrong color for a frame
